meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: Instructional personnel are subject to suspension or dismissal as provided for in Sections 1012.33, 1012.335 and 1012.34, Florida Statutes. The procedure for suspension, dismissal and return to annual contract status for Continuing Contract teachers shall be governed by Sec. 1012.33(4), F.S. The hearing shall be conducted in accordance with Sec. 120.569 and 120.57, F.S. Any such decision adverse to the employee may be appealed by the employee pursuant to Sec. 120.68, F.S. The Uniform Rules of Procedure, Chapter 120, and Board policy 0133 shall govern shall apply to and govern the Board’s quasi-judicial proceedings as applicable. If a teacher who holds a professional service contract as provided in Sec. 1012.33 is not performing his or her duties in a satisfactory manner, the evaluator shall notify the teacher in writing of such determination. ...if a transfer is granted pursuant to Sections 1012.27(1) and 1012.28(6), it does not extend the period for correcting performance deficiencies. The hearing shall be conducted in accordance with chapter 120. Any high school credit classes shall comply with Sec. 1003.436, F.S. Sufficient staffing shall be provided to meet required state statutes. The Board shall adopt policies to ensure equal rights to all teachers as per the Florida Education Equity Act, Chapter 1000.05 F.S. There will be a Grandfathered Salary Schedule and a Performance Salary Schedule in accordance with s. 1012.22 F.S. Credit on the instructional salary schedule will be granted for all verified public school experience in accordance with state law. To meet the requirements of state law regarding virtual instruction and to fulfill student course requests, the District will hire teachers to instruct, monitor, evaluate and support student progress in its virtual instruction program known as Pinellas Virtual School (PVS).
